**Procter & Gamble (fiscal year ending June 30, 2026).** I couldn't retrieve the filing, so these figures are estimates built on fiscal 2025 results and the first half of fiscal 2026. I assumed net sales of about $84.5 billion and net earnings of about $15.8 billion. That gives a net margin of about 18.7%.

**Gap.** 18.7% minus 3.1% is about 15.6 percentage points.
